estimator: For each word and candidate sign, p=k/L; observed boundary indicators are compared with sum(p), variance sum(p*(1-p)). Zero-variance views are unscorable. Singletons contribute deterministic expectation and zero variance.
null: Independent uniform within-word permutations preserve each word multiset and length. Ordered first/final draws without replacement implement exactly the relevant boundary marginal of that permutation; all candidates share each simulated boundary draw.
bootstrap: Resample complete documents with replacement; all candidate draws share the same document weights. Report conditional z quantiles and unscorable replicate counts; no significance interpretation of bootstrap quantiles.
percentile: Empirical inverse CDF: sorted values at ceil(p*n)-1, bounded below by zero; median uses midpoint for even n.
pvalue: One-sided observed boundary count enrichment, p=(exceedances+1)/(5000+1); ineligible candidates receive p=1 for the fixed family.

multiplicity.families: Token and deduplicated-type views are separate declared diagnostic families; no combined discovery claim or selection of the stronger view.

interpretation: Conditional descriptive structural sensitivity on the historical corpus. Candidates were selected using this corpus: Holm corrects the displayed fixed family only and does not undo selection bias. Neither view establishes independent replication, morphology, a language, or decipherment. Prospective 3.1 and known-answer calibration remain blocked.
